name: Isa Tippens
bio: As a software developer, Isa plays a key role in handling the intricate flow of pricing data into outgoing orders. His intellectual curiosity extends to his academic life, where he is currently pursuing an MSc in Computer Science at the University of the Western Cape, with a specialized focus on quantum computing and communication.

His contributions at Alpha Crest are central to the company’s success. Isa simultaneously develops our trading and back-testing systems and tools while also managing the essential cloud infrastructure that powers our technological operations. He is a results-driven professional, known for his meticulous attention to even the smallest, yet most critical, details.

A true enthusiast at heart, Isa’s passion for building software is matched by his keen interest in the ever-evolving landscapes of technology and cybersecurity. When his not coding or studying, you can find him tackling new heights as a budding rock climber.
